title: Do Machine Learning Ensembles Beat Published Quotas? Target Parameterization, Censored Baselines, and Conformal Intervals Under Admissions Reform
abstract: arXiv:2611.34104v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Public admission capacity caps published prior to matriculation are widely used by ministries and institutional analysts as default intake projections in centralized postsecondary clearinghouses. Using an audited 2022 to 2026 Vietnamese undergraduate panel (26,895 program-year records across 309 universities) linked to strictly lagged t-1 occupational vacancy signals, this paper evaluates machine learning, multilevel, and censored econometric estimators against published quotas across 5,385 continuing 2024 programs (five-fold university-grouped cross-validation) and 3,348 matched (2,179 grain-consistent) 2025 programs strictly out of time. Because 62.8% of 2024 programs enroll their exact published quota, unanchored log-growth ensembles degrade accuracy, while the worst 5% generate half of total quota error via unfilled "phantom capacity." translated_title: 机器学习集成方法能否胜过公布的招生名额？招生改革下的目标参数化、截尾基线与保形区间
translated_abstract: 在集中式高等教育统筹体系中，入学前公布的公共招生容量上限被各部委和机构分析人员广泛用作默认的入学预测依据。本文利用经过审计的2022至2026年越南本科面板数据（涵盖309所高校的26,895个项目-年度记录），并将其与严格滞后的t-1期职业空缺信号相关联，在5,385个2024年延续项目（采用五折按大学分组交叉验证）以及3,348个匹配的2025年项目（其中2,179个粒度一致，严格进行时间外验证）上，将机器学习、多层模型和截尾计量经济学估计方法与公布的招生名额进行对比评估。由于62.8%的2024年项目恰好录取其公布的招生名额，无锚定的对数增长集成方法降低了预测准确性，而表现最差的5%项目通过未填满的“幻影容量”贡献了总名额误差的一半。受控目标消融实验（包括在放宽的非约束性截剪条件下的单因子测试）……
tldr: 该研究基于越南2022-2026年本科招生面板数据，发现由于多数项目恰好按公布名额录取，结合截尾基线与保形区间的公布名额预测优于无锚定的机器学习集成方法，且最差5%项目的“幻影容量”贡献了一半以上的名额预测误差。
en_tdlr: Using a Vietnamese 2022-2026 undergraduate admissions panel, this paper shows that published quotas with censored econometric baselines and conformal intervals beat unanchored machine learning ensembles, as most programs enroll exactly their published quotas and the worst 5% of programs generate half of total quota error via unfilled "phantom capacity."
